data.name: UIButtonConstructorTitle
data.value: Do not use the factory-backed UIButton constructor when subclassing

data.name: UIButtonConstructorMessage
data.value: UIButton(UIButtonType) cannot initialize a UIButton subclass because it wraps an object returned by a native factory. Use a supported base constructor when subclassing.

data.name: UIButtonConstructorDescription
data.value: UIButton(UIButtonType) calls the native buttonWithType: factory on UIButton, rather than initializing a native instance of the managed subclass. Use the default constructor or another supported initializer when subclassing. Direct construction with new UIButton(type) is valid.
